title: network-policies chart values schema
description: Plan 2026-05-20 T2.5 ext — fail-fast on egress posture misconfiguration. Critical because T8.5b deep-review-remediation 3-layer rollout (defaultDenyEgress + loopRuntimeSystemAllowEgress + namespaces) requires precise toggles. Typo in boolean = silent egress allow/deny inversion = data leak OR DOS at deploy time.

defaultDenyIngress.description: When true, all inbound traffic to enforced namespaces is rejected unless explicitly allowed. Default: true (safe — egress is the more complex side).

defaultDenyEgress.description: When true, ALL outbound from enforced namespaces is rejected unless allowed by loopRuntimeSystemAllowEgress rules. Default: false (T8.5c staging soak gate). Apply order per edge-case review: loopRuntimeSystemAllowEgress first, then defaultDenyEgress.

loopRuntimeSystemAllowEgress.description: When true, per-component allow-egress NetworkPolicies are installed. SAFE to enable independently — additive to namespace without default-deny is no-op. MUST be true before defaultDenyEgress=true.

items.description: K8s namespace name — RFC 1123 lowercase DNS label (1-63 chars, [a-z0-9-], no leading/trailing dash).

namespaces.description: Namespaces where these policies apply. At least one required (otherwise chart installs no resources).
